full_prompt_en: A square aerial photograph looks obliquely over a long transport corridor cutting diagonally through a patchwork of agricultural fields. The route enters from the lower left and runs toward the upper right, almost dividing the frame into two colorful halves. Along its edges, tightly packed rows of freight containers and small industrial structures make a bright ribbon of repeated rectangular units. Their sides alternate in yellow, orange, blue, green, white, and rust. On both sides of the corridor, broad fields form an ordered mosaic of long geometric strips and larger rectangular plots. Some are pale tan or cream, others dusty blue, muted green, red-brown, or ocher. Thin service roads and straight boundaries separate these color blocks. The camera is high enough that people are absent and individual objects become graphic marks, yet low enough that container stacks cast short shadows and reveal volume. The upper fields soften into a slight atmospheric blur, while the near sections retain sharper detail. Daylight is clear and warm, enriching the saturated container colors and defining their edges without harsh black shadows. The composition depends on repetition and scale: a single strong diagonal axis intersects many perpendicular and parallel field lines. Buildings near the route look small and rhythmic rather than monumental. The picture reads first as a carefully organized abstract grid, then resolves into land use, transportation, and storage. Its restrained aerial perspective turns ordinary infrastructure into a vivid pattern of movement and color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形航拍照片斜俯视一条长运输走廊，切过拼布般的农田。路线从左下进入，通向右上，几乎把画面分为两片彩色区域。沿路线边缘，紧密排列的货柜和小型工业结构形成一道由重复矩形单元组成的亮带。柜体侧面在黄、橙、蓝、绿、白和锈色之间交替。走廊两边，宽阔田地构成有序马赛克，由长几何条和较大矩形田块组成。有些浅棕或奶油色，另一些是蒙尘蓝、低饱和绿、红褐或赭色。细小服务道路和笔直地界将色块隔开。相机高度足以使人物消失、单个物件成为图形标记，却又足够低，让货柜堆投下短阴影并显出体量。上方远田渐入轻微空气模糊，近处仍有较清晰细节。日光明亮而温暖，丰富饱和货柜颜色，界定边缘却不形成尖锐黑影。构图依赖重复与尺度：一条强斜轴穿过许多垂直和平行的田线。路线附近房屋显得小而有节奏，并不宏大。画面第一眼像精心组织的抽象网格，随后才显出土地利用、运输与储存。克制的空中透视把普通基础设施变成有活力的移动与颜色图案。
style_prompt_en: Oblique aerial photography transforms a large real surface into a graphic network of long strips, repeated small rectangles, and one dominant diagonal axis. Warm clear daylight gives color blocks crisp boundaries and modest short shadows, while distance softens slightly toward the top. Ocher, tan, dusty blue, muted green, rust, and brighter primary accents form a patterned mosaic. Keep enough three-dimensional detail in repeated units to prevent the view from becoming pure abstraction. The composition balances systematic order with tiny irregularities, revealing scale through accumulation rather than people.
style_prompt_zh: 斜向航拍摄影把大型真实表面化成由长条、重复小矩形和一条主导斜轴组成的图形网络。温暖清亮日光给色块清楚边界及适度短影，距离向上方略微柔化。赭黄、棕褐、蒙尘蓝、低饱和绿、锈色和更亮的原色重音组成花纹马赛克。重复单元仍保留足够三维细节，使画面不完全成为抽象。构图平衡系统秩序与微小不规则，通过累积而非人物表现尺度。
theme_en: An oblique aerial view of colored fields, freight containers, and a long rail corridor
theme_zh: 斜俯视彩色田块、货柜与长铁路走廊
name: Alex MacLean
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
